<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE scxml [
  <!ENTITY % shared "<!ENTITY greeting 'hello'>">
  %shared;
  <!ENTITY states "<state id='a'><transition event='go' target='b'/></state><final id='b'/>">
  <!ATTLIST scxml xmlns CDATA #FIXED "http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
                  version CDATA "1.0">
]>
<scxml datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="text" expr="'&greeting;'"/>
  </datamodel>
  &states;
</scxml>
